# Python script check for monophyly of trees. No need to run it, it is called for in "batch_label_trees.py"

```{python, eval=FALSE}

class Node:
    __slots__ = ("name", "length", "children", "parent", "label")

    def __init__(self, name=None, length=None):
        self.name = name
        self.length = length
        self.children = []
        self.parent = None
        self.label = None

    def is_leaf(self):
        return len(self.children) == 0

    def add_child(self, child):
        child.parent = self
        self.children.append(child)

    def leaves(self):
        if self.is_leaf():
            return [self]
        out = []
        for c in self.children:
            out.extend(c.leaves())
        return out

    def leaf_names(self):
        return {n.name for n in self.leaves()}


def parse_newick(s):
    s = s.strip()
    if s.endswith(";"):
        s = s[:-1]
    s = "".join(s.split())

    pos = [0]

    def parse_clade():
        node = Node()
        if s[pos[0]] == "(":
            pos[0] += 1
            while True:
                child = parse_clade()
                node.add_child(child)
                if s[pos[0]] == ",":
                    pos[0] += 1
                    continue
                elif s[pos[0]] == ")":
                    pos[0] += 1
                    break
            name, length = parse_name_and_length()
            node.name = name
            node.length = length
        else:
            name, length = parse_name_and_length()
            node.name = name
            node.length = length
        return node

    def parse_name_and_length():
        start = pos[0]
        while pos[0] < len(s) and s[pos[0]] not in ",();":
            pos[0] += 1
        token = s[start:pos[0]].strip()
        name = None
        length = None
        if ":" in token:
            name_part, length_part = token.split(":", 1)
            name = name_part.strip() or None
            length_part = length_part.strip()
            if "#" in length_part:
                length_part = length_part.split("#")[0].strip()
            length = float(length_part) if length_part else None
        else:
            name = token.strip() or None
        return name, length

    root = parse_clade()
    return root


def find_mrca(root, taxa):
    """Return the MRCA node of a set of leaf names."""
    taxa = set(taxa)
    all_leaves = {leaf.name: leaf for leaf in root.leaves()}
    missing = taxa - set(all_leaves.keys())
    if missing:
        raise ValueError(f"Taxa not found in tree: {missing}")

    def ancestor_path(leaf_node):
        path = []
        n = leaf_node
        while n is not None:
            path.append(n)
            n = n.parent
        return path

    paths = [ancestor_path(all_leaves[t]) for t in taxa]
    common = set(paths[0])
    for p in paths[1:]:
        common &= set(p)
    for node in paths[0]:
        if node in common:
            return node
    raise RuntimeError("No common ancestor found -- tree may be malformed")


def is_descendant(node, ancestor):
    n = node
    while n is not None:
        if n is ancestor:
            return True
        n = n.parent
    return False


def reparent(node, new_parent, connecting_length):
    old_parent = node.parent
    if old_parent is not None:
        old_parent.children = [c for c in old_parent.children if c is not node]
        original_edge_length = node.length
        reparent(old_parent, node, original_edge_length)
    node.parent = new_parent
    node.length = connecting_length
    if new_parent is not None:
        new_parent.children.append(node)


def collapse_unary_nodes(root):
    def _collapse(node):
        node.children = [_collapse(c) for c in node.children]
        while len(node.children) == 1:
            only_child = node.children[0]
            if node.length is not None and only_child.length is not None:
                only_child.length = node.length + only_child.length
            elif only_child.length is None:
                only_child.length = node.length
            only_child.parent = node.parent
            return _collapse(only_child)
        return node

    return _collapse(root)


def reroot_on_outgroup(root, outgroup_name):
    """Reroots the tree on a given outgroup taxon or outgroup clade MRCA."""
    if isinstance(outgroup_name, str):
        outgroup_set = {outgroup_name}
    else:
        outgroup_set = set(outgroup_name)

    all_leaves = {leaf.name: leaf for leaf in root.leaves()}
    missing_ogs = outgroup_set - set(all_leaves.keys())
    if missing_ogs:
        raise ValueError(f"Outgroup(s) '{missing_ogs}' not found in tree.")

    if len(outgroup_set) == 1:
        target_node = all_leaves[next(iter(outgroup_set))]
    else:
        target_node = find_mrca(root, outgroup_set)

    old_parent = target_node.parent

    if old_parent is None:
        return root

    node_length = target_node.length if target_node.length is not None else 0.0
    half = node_length / 2.0

    old_parent.children = [c for c in old_parent.children if c is not target_node]

    new_root = Node(name=None, length=None)
    target_node.parent = new_root
    target_node.length = half
    new_root.children.append(target_node)

    reparent(old_parent, new_root, half)

    new_root = collapse_unary_nodes(new_root)
    return new_root


def check_outgroup_monophyly(root, outgroup_name, foreground_taxa):
    """Verifies that none of the outgroup taxa fall inside the foreground MRCA clade."""
    if isinstance(outgroup_name, str):
        outgroup_set = {outgroup_name}
    else:
        outgroup_set = set(outgroup_name)

    all_leaves = {leaf.name for leaf in root.leaves()}
    missing_ogs = outgroup_set - all_leaves
    if missing_ogs:
        return False, None, None, f"Outgroup taxon/taxa '{missing_ogs}' not found in tree."

    missing_fg = set(foreground_taxa) - all_leaves
    if missing_fg:
        return False, None, None, f"Foreground taxa not found in tree: {missing_fg}"

    rerooted = reroot_on_outgroup(root, outgroup_set)

    mrca = find_mrca(rerooted, foreground_taxa)
    outgroup_leaves = [leaf for leaf in rerooted.leaves() if leaf.name in outgroup_set]

    for og_leaf in outgroup_leaves:
        if is_descendant(og_leaf, mrca):
            return (
                False,
                rerooted,
                mrca,
                f"NON-MONOPHYLETIC even after rerooting on '{outgroup_set}': an outgroup "
                f"({og_leaf.name}) falls within the foreground clade (genuine gene "
                f"tree discordance -- ILS, introgression, paralogy -- not just an "
                f"unrooted-tree display artifact). Needs manual review.",
            )

    return True, rerooted, mrca, "OK: monophyletic once rooted on the outgroup."
```
